turnout.notes: North Dakota turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native eligible-voter turnout artifact is collected and reconciled. North Dakota does not require voter registration; the official SOS dashboard reports eligible voters instead of a registered-voter denominator.

reviewCharts.warning: North Dakota review rows are same-key President-versus-U.S.-Senate precinct rows from the official SOS ResultsAjax dashboard endpoint. Rows are advisory source-review context only, not findings. The active turnout denominator remains EAC fallback with a zero registered-voter denominator because North Dakota does not require voter registration; state-native eligible-voter denominator replacement still needs reconciliation.
